summary: Red team of the accepted library audit AUDIT-05 (five Tau Ceti roadmaps: PolynomialGaloisGroups, QuadraticFormInvariants, the completed ContourIntegration and OrthogonalL2Bases, and ConformalMapping). Every one of the 695 cited declarations exists at the pinned commits. 40 findings: 3 high, 9 medium, 28 low. The three high ones: ConformalMapping L5 is marked conditional although Tau Ceti proves the closure homeomorphism outright (exists_homeomorph_closedBall_closure_of_isJordanCurve_frontier, Jordan/Approach.lean:213, sorry-free); ContourIntegration Layer 1's HW Props 2.2 and 2.3 are proved only when the curve's basepoint avoids the point, so they are partial, not built; and QuadraticFormInvariants Layer 3's binary quaternion lemma is marked absent although Mathlib's CliffordAlgebraQuaternion.equiv and CliffordAlgebra.equivOfIsometry give it. The medium ones: library material marked absent (Equiv.Perm.partition, polynomial lifting to monic polynomials of fixed degree, the square-class dictionary), private Mathlib lemmas cited as if importable, overclaims (finite index of the power subgroup, the Schwarz–Pick equality case, corner-free arc FTC, the Chebyshev basis construction), and summaries that say everything is built.
